answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 461 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tide. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the velvet queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. The canyon index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The bill scales 23 fold, not the vote. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
